besluite.fout: The possessive 'se' follows the bracketed English name, so on a first reading it attaches to 'Tutankhamun' and the reader has to reach back past the bracket to the subject.
besluite.rede: 'Die graf van Toetankamen (in Engels: Tutankhamun)' reads cleanly, keeps both protected names and the one-per-lesson English gloss intact, and says exactly the same thing.
